title: Animal loot is better
description: Animal mob loot is better. This data pack adds to all animals loot leathers/hides, bones/bone meals.
body:
### General
This data pack adds to all animals loot leathers/hides, bones/bone meals. Some mobs adds strings or unique items
### Looting
Looting enchantment impact the amount of items in loot. Each level of enchantment increases the maximum amount of items dropped by one
### See details in changelog
